{{Top}}
A '''snap shot''' was a shot taken in haste at an enemy craft as it passed before a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] weapons. Though the chances of scoring on such a shot were small, it could nonetheless spook a rookie [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] into making a mistake. Some pilots were skilled at making such high-deflection shots, scoring hits on enemy craft more often than was the norm.
